problems_addressed.specific_problem: High rate of deals falling through after going under contract
problems_addressed.solution_summary: Implement the '30-day grip' system to maintain communication and manage client expectations.

target_avatars.key_takeaway: Consistent communication and proactive management during the escrow period can significantly reduce deal cancellations.

key_tactics.context: Call the client within 24 hours of mutual acceptance to outline the next month's process and potential stress points.
Every Tuesday, contact your client, the other agent, the lender, and title to check on the deal's progress.
Proactively address issues during inspection, appraisal, and clear to close by contacting clients first.

quotable_insights: The cheapest deal you win all year is the one you already have.

episode_summary: In this episode, D.J. Paris discusses the high rate of real estate deals falling through after going under contract and introduces the '30-day grip' system to improve client management during escrow. By implementing proactive communication strategies, agents can reduce cancellations and ensure more deals reach closing.
